customer: Good afternoon, I'm hoping you can help me. I'm retired and planning to sell my electric car to Northwind Auto, but I remarried last year and the title still has my old surname while my driver's license shows my new one. Will that be a problem, and is there anything I should bring along?
agent: Thank you for checking ahead, that's no problem at all. As covered in our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID," please bring the document that shows the change, which in your case would be your marriage certificate. You'll also sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at your appointment. If you notice any spelling mistakes on the title itself, please ask the Dunmore motor vehicle agency to correct those first.
